issue.title: Bob Mac Capture Refs panel: show a vN chip for reread families

task_type_fields.proposal: Show a reading-number chip in the Bob Mac Capture Refs panel, matching `bob ref list`/`show`: `vN` for N >= 2, and `v1` on a family root that has later readings. bob-cli-c9 (`bob ref create -f`, rereads named `<root>__vN`) already exposes the data: `bob ref list -f json` rows carry `reading` (null outside a family; 1 for a family root, N for later readings) and `earlier` (`target`, `label`, `kind`), and `bob ref show -f json` adds `later`; see docs/ref.md (JSON section) and the family phase commit 16f86b7d. Per decisions:mac-capture-is-a-thin-client the panel must render only what bob reports (never parse stems such as `__v2`, which can also be natural names like `protocol__v2` with no family). Proposed by bob-cli-c9.6 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note 3) and listed as out of scope in plan:202610/ref_create_force_recapture.md.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: bob-cli-c9 is a bob-cli epic whose plan explicitly lists client chips in Bob Mac Capture as out of scope (proposed follow-ups); the work lives in the bob-mac-capture linked repo.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-c9.6 note 3; bob now reports reading numbers for reread families but the Mac Refs panel does not render them.

payload.description: Same reading-number chip for reread families on the other client; keep wording and v1/vN rules consistent
